title: Avalanche Simulation with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D avalanche simulation on mountainous terrain using Three.js. Load the asset 'horse.glb' using GLTFLoader as a decorative element (a frozen horse statue) placed on the terrain slope.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 40, 60) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (10, 50, 10) with intensity 0.8 casting shadows.
- Create mountainous terrain using a PlaneGeometry(100, 100, 64, 64) rotated to face up, with vertex displacement to form a slope: vertices should rise from z=-50 (height=0) to z=50 (height=30) forming a mountain slope. Color the terrain white/grey to look snowy.
- Load 'horse.glb' and place it at position (5, 0, 10) on the slope, scaled to fit (scale ~3). The horse acts as an obstacle.
- Create an avalanche particle system: an array of 200 small white spheres (radius 0.3) initially clustered at the top of the slope near position (0, 28, 45), all inactive/hidden.

PHYSICS BEHAVIOR:
- When the simulation starts, particles become active and roll downhill under gravity.
- Each particle has velocity {x, y, z} and is affected by gravity (acceleration y = -9.8 scaled for visual effect, use -15 units/s²).
- Particles follow the terrain slope: they should move in the -z direction (downhill) with slight random x-drift.
- Particles bounce off the horse model's bounding box (treat it as a box collider at its position, width ~4, depth ~4).
- Particles stop when they reach the bottom of the slope (z < -40) or y < 0.3.
- Track simulation time in seconds.

UNDO/REDO SYSTEM:
- Every 1 second of simulation, save a snapshot of all particle positions and velocities to a history stack.
- Maximum 30 snapshots in history.
- Pressing 'U' key undoes to the previous snapshot (restores all particle positions/velocities).
- Pressing 'R' key redoes to the next snapshot (if available after undo).
- Display current snapshot index and total snapshots in HUD.

USER INTERACTIONS:
- A 'Start Avalanche' button (id='startBtn') triggers the simulation.
- A 'Reset' button (id='resetBtn') resets everything to initial state.
- Press 'U' for undo, 'R' for redo.
- Press 'P' to pause/resume the simulation.

HUD/UI:
- Display at top-left: simulation time, particle count (active), snapshot index, paused status.
- 'Start Avalanche' and 'Reset' buttons at top-right.

STATE MANAGEMENT - expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- simulationStarted: boolean
- simulationTime: number (seconds elapsed)
- activeParticles: number (particles still moving)
- totalParticles: 200
- paused: boolean
- snapshotIndex: number (current position in history, starts at -1 before any snapshot)
- totalSnapshots: number (total saved snapshots)
- horseLoaded: boolean (true when GLB model loaded)
- horsePosition: {x, y, z}
- particlesStopped: number (particles that reached bottom or stopped)
- undoCount: number (times undo was pressed)
- redoCount: number (times redo was pressed)
- canUndo: boolean
- canRedo: boolean

Use requestAnimationFrame for the render loop. Delta-time based physics updates.
physics_constraints: Gravity acceleration of -15 units/s² on Y axis. Particles must follow terrain slope downhill (-Z direction). Bounding box collision with horse model. Particles stop at y<0.3 or z<-40. Snapshot history captures positions and velocities every 1 second. Undo restores previous snapshot, redo restores next. Maximum 30 snapshots.
